verdict.rationale: Omnara's 'Skills' feature lets users package reusable instructions and supporting files for agents (omnara-docs-6, omnara-docs-18), which could be repurposed to hold codebase conventions, but there is no explicit documentation of a repo-level context file (like CLAUDE.md) that is automatically loaded to inform plans/code generation. missing for 10: explicit support for a dedicated codebase-conventions context file, evidence that agents automatically ingest such a file when generating plans/code, independent confirmation of this use case.
